site.name: al-Marṣad
coverage.label: Coverage: {value}
coverage.explain.stub: A stub is little more than a name, and has not been reviewed by a scholar.
coverage.explain.outline: An outline records some facts, but the record is not yet sourced.
coverage.explain.sourced: Its facts point to sources, but a scholar has not yet reviewed them.
coverage.explain.reviewed: A scholar has reviewed this record.
status.label: Status: {value}
claims.legend: Each claim shows its status. “Proposed” means put forward but not yet checked by a scholar; “accepted” means a scholar has accepted it. Where no status is recorded, no review is recorded either.
claims.ai_note: Claims that cite a story come from a document that was generated with AI. Its authenticity is unknown and scholars have not reviewed it.
facts.no_status: These facts are recorded directly on this record, not as claims, so they carry no review status.
prophet.note: Below are the stories, events and ties recorded about him, each with its own status and source.
story.banner: Draft, not yet reviewed by scholars
story.no_text: The text of this story is not yet recorded.
story.ai_note: This story comes from a document that was generated with AI. Its authenticity is unknown and scholars have not reviewed it.
details.heading: Details
details.summary: Names as recorded, who recorded what, and raw data
details.basis_heading: Basis statements recorded with the claims
date.converted: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} days
date.converted_one: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date ({method}); it may be off by up to {days} day
date.converted_plain: Gregorian date converted from the Hijri date
date.relative: Dated relative to another event or period; no date is worked out here
home.title: al-Marṣad
home.title_suffix: The Seerah and the Companions' generation
home.lead: al-Marṣad is a working prototype: a record of the Seerah and the Companions' generation in which every person, event, place, group and story has its own page, and every claim shows how far it has been checked.
home.story_door: Prefer to read? Start with the {stories}: short narratives, each followed by the people in it and how far each claim has been checked.
home.status_heading: What is verified, and what is not
home.status_claims: {total} claims are recorded: {proposed} proposed, {under_review} under review, {accepted} accepted.
home.status_records: Records: {stub} stub, {outline} outline, {sourced} sourced, {reviewed} reviewed, {verified} verified.
home.status_unstated: Links such as who took part in an event, or where it took place, are recorded without any status.
home.status_none: No claim on this site has been accepted by a scholar yet.
home.how_top: The top of a page says who or what it is in a few words, using only what is recorded.
home.how_claims: Below that come the claims, each with its status and its source.
home.how_details: At the bottom, Details gives the names as recorded, who recorded each claim, and the raw identifiers and data.
home.names_note: Names are shown in a popular spelling. The scholarly spelling is under Details on each page.
glossary.title: Glossary of Arabic terms
glossary.lead: Terms that appear in this site's labels. A definition is shown only where the project's own documents already give one, quoted as written; scholars have not reviewed these wordings.
glossary.none_defined: No term has a definition in the project's documents yet.
glossary.needed_lead: These terms appear in the data but have no definition in the project's documents yet.
